name: CartNexo – Abandoned Cart Recovery
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Over 70% of WooCommerce checkouts are abandoned. Stop leaving money on the table!

CartNexo Abandoned Cart Recovery is an enterprise-grade, lightweight engine that silently captures customer data as they type and deploys highly converting, automated email follow-ups to rescue lost orders.

Built for modern WooCommerce stores, CartNexo replaces expensive monthly SaaS platforms with a completely free, high-performance plugin that won’t slow down your checkout.

📖 View Official Documentation | 🚀 Upgrade to PRO

🌟 Unmatched Free Features

⚡ Smart Checkout Capture
* Silent Background Capture: Instantly captures emails, names, phone numbers, and full addresses the moment a customer clicks out of a field.
* Universal Compatibility: Works flawlessly on both Classic Shortcode checkouts and the modern WooCommerce Block Checkouts.
* Auto-Capture for Logged-in Users: Automatically grabs cart data for logged-in buyers without them needing to type anything.

🛒 1-Click Auto-Restore & Pre-Fill
* Eliminate 90% of checkout friction. When a customer clicks the recovery link in their email, CartNexo automatically rebuilds their shopping cart and magically pre-fills their Name, Email, Phone, and Address fields!

💌 Premium HTML Email Themes
* Say goodbye to ugly plain-text emails. Choose from 4 professionally designed, conversion-optimized HTML themes (Modern Minimalist, Flash Sale, Visual Showcase, and Founder Nudge).
* Rich Product Tables: Automatically generates a beautiful HTML summary table of the customer’s cart, complete with product images, quantities, and prices.
* Dynamic Tags: Personalize your copy using {first_name}, {cart_total}, {items_table}, {checkout_url}, and {store_name}.

⚙️ Advanced Automation Control
* Self-Healing WP-Cron Engine: Guarantees your scheduled emails fire precisely when they should (e.g., 15m, 30m, 1h, or 2h after abandonment).
* Custom Sender Override: Send emails from your custom brand name and address (e.g., Sarah from MyStore <hello@mystore.com>) to boost open rates and bypass spam filters.
* Spam Domain Blacklist: Automatically block bot submissions from fake domains like qq.com or mailinator.com.
* Minimum Cart Threshold: Only trigger emails for carts worth over a specific dollar amount.

🛡️ Admin Tools & Compliance
* GDPR Notice Toggle: Easily display a compliant “We save your cart so you can resume anytime” notice under the checkout email field.
* High-Value Cart Alerts: Automatically receive an email notification as the store owner whenever a cart worth $100+ is abandoned.
* 1-Click Test Emails: Send a live test email directly to your inbox to verify your SMTP settings and template design.
* CSV Lead Export: Download your captured abandoned emails for manual Facebook, Google Ads, or TikTok retargeting.
* Live Dashboard: Track “Recovered Revenue,” pending carts, and conversion rates from a stunning, modern React-style Tailwind interface.

🚀 Unlock CartNexo PRO

Want to put your revenue recovery on steroids? Upgrade to the Pro Edition at yeasinwp.com:

  • 🤖 3-Step Drip Campaigns: Trigger multi-sequence automated follow-ups at customized delays (e.g., 15m, 4h, 24h).
  • 🎫 Dynamic Auto-Expiring Coupons: Generate single-use, FOMO-inducing discount codes automatically.
  • ⚡ Exit-Intent Recovery Popups: Capture abandoned emails via popups before customers even leave the site.
  • 📱 WhatsApp Integration: Recover carts instantly via direct WhatsApp messages.
  • 📊 Advanced Revenue Analytics: Deep-dive charts and tracking metrics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cartnexo-abandoned-cart-recovery directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> CartNexo Email.
  4. Choose your Email Theme, set your “From” email, and configure your WP-Cron delay.
  5. Watch the recovered revenue roll in!
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my checkout page?

Not at all. CartNexo uses highly optimized, debounced background AJAX requests that execute silently without interrupting the user experience or page load times.

Does it work with the new WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes! CartNexo v1.0.1+ is fully compatible with both Classic Checkouts and the modern React-based WooCommerce Block Checkouts.

Are the emails GDPR Compliant?

Yes. You can enable the built-in GDPR notice for your checkout page, and every recovery email automatically includes a 1-click Unsubscribe link that honors CAN-SPAM and GDPR regulations.

Why are my emails not sending automatically?

Ensure your WordPress server has a functional Cron Job system. If your host blocks WP-Cron, you may need to set up a real server-side cron job. You can easily verify your system health via the “Automation Timing” card in the CartNexo settings!
